intuition: A range continues while each next sorted value is exactly one greater than the previous value.

brute_force.approach: For every input value, search ahead to determine the end of its consecutive run.

optimal.approach: Walk each run once and format its start and end as either one number or a range.

edge_cases: An empty input returns no ranges.
A singleton run is formatted as one number.
The input is sorted and contains unique values.
